body:
First it's important to for the reader to know this isnt my first experience using either or these drugs, nor is it my first experience mixing the two.  I have done heroin roughly 30 times, cocaine 10 times, and mixed the two one two separate equations.
Ok! On to the experience.
I have a slight addiction with heroin, and I drive far to get it, today I made a trip with my friend (Joekz) who also has the same addiction.  The night before I had blown close to a half gram of 'peruvian flake' cocaine, some $100 per gram cocaine, fine stuff.  I really wanted to get a few packs because I felt a slight but nagging comedown from the night before.  Me and my friend headed to the block around 5:30pm, we go early because we do not like going to this place at night.  This trip happened to be especially aggravating because of all the construction in michigan.  I bought 5 packs of originals, and my friend a bundle of dog food packs (knockouts).  We headed home and nearly got lost, but made it.  We arrived at his house around 6:40pm, and went upstairs to get our fix.  I snorted all five of my packs, and my friend did one.  We were watching dude wheres my car.
[Erowid Note: 
Driving while intoxicated, tripping, or extremely sleep deprived is dangerous and irresponsible because it endangers other people.
Don't do it!
]
I began to feel the effects in under a minute, instantly relaxing my entire body.  The feeling of euphoria creeps up on me with heroin, but when it hits its amazing, a feeling of ultimate goodness, safety, and pleasure.  Yeah, that warm fuzzy feeling.  Kind of like love.  Half an hour passed and the euphoria wore off, but the heroin was still in full effect, my friend and I sat around just feeling amazing for close to 3 hours I think, until around 9 or so, and left for our good friend de-rrewws house, where our other friend persy was also.  On the way we smoked 2 bowls of reggos, and it made me feel even better.  Smoking weed on heroin is great, it takes the edge off, and relaxes me into a sweet oblivious, careless state.  It makes nodding off 100 times easier.  We arrvied around 9:20 and went downstairs to blow some of the quality cocaine my friend joekz saved from the previous night.  We all did a line.  I instantly felt this fresh new feeling of perfectness, the heroins groggy effect was eliminated, but the relaxation was all there, the cocaine made the total high so pure, and incredible, that I had to do more, but I always do with coke.  I blew another 2 small lines and headed home.  On the way home I felt the best I ever have with these two drugs, the negative effects of each eliminated, and a surging full blown heroin effect on my body, and racing thoughs and happiness filling my brain.  I arrived at my house and logged onto the computer, ready to document this great experience.
